platformRules.rateLimit: At most {{posts}} posts per {{window}} from one account.
platformRules.disclosureFlag: It is set as the platform's own flag ({{flag}}).
platformRules.disclosureLine: It is a line at the end of the post: "{{text}}"
platformRules.requiredGeneratedMedia: Required when the post carries media Guaardvark generated.
platformRules.requiredAiAssisted: Required when the post carries generated media or text an agent drafted.
platformRules.noPlatformRule: No platform rule; the composer's switch adds it when you turn it on.
platformRules.scheduledByGuaardvark: Guaardvark publishes a scheduled post at its time, so Guaardvark must be running then.
platformRules.heldByPlatform: The platform holds a scheduled post and publishes it itself ({{field}}).
platformRules.heldByPlatformVisibility: The platform holds a scheduled {{visibilities}} post and publishes it itself ({{field}}).
platformRules.heldByPlatformLead: The platform holds a scheduled post and publishes it itself ({{field}}) when the time is more than {{window}} away.
platformRules.heldByPlatformVisibilityLead: The platform holds a scheduled {{visibilities}} post and publishes it itself ({{field}}) when the time is more than {{window}} away.
platformRules.otherwiseGuaardvark: Otherwise Guaardvark publishes it at its time, so Guaardvark must be running then.
platformRules.notDeletable: Posts cannot be deleted from Guaardvark.
platformRules.deleteWindow: Delete on platform works for {{window}} after posting.
platformRules.deleteAlways: Delete on platform is available for every post.
platformRules.fixedVisibilityOne: {{visibility}} on {{targets}}: the only visibility it offers.
platformRules.fixedVisibilityMany: {{visibility}} on {{targets}}: the only visibility they offer.
platformRules.deleteWindowClosed: The platform allows deleting only within {{window}} of posting.

oauthCode.unreadable: That address could not be read. Paste it again, or just the code.
oauthCode.denied: Access was not granted: {{reason}}. Authorize again.
oauthCode.noCode: That address has no authorization code in it.
oauthCode.otherAttempt: That address is from a different authorization attempt. Press Authorize again and use the new one.

postFields.scheduleHelp: Still waits for approval first when approval is required.
postFields.title: Title
postFields.linkHelp: Sent with the text. Leave empty for none.

posts.title: Social Posts
posts.emptyBody: Write one with New post, or publish from Media or the Studio with the Publish action; posts show here with their status.
posts.saved: Saved. It still waits for approval on the Approvals page.
posts.deleteTitleUnknown: Delete this post on the platform?
posts.deleteScheduled: The platform still holds this post for its time. Deleting it there means it never goes out.
posts.deletePosted: Removes the post from the platform. Its record stays here, marked deleted.

accounts.botLabelTooltip: Run Test to read it from the platform.

rules.publicOptIn: {{label}} (set per account on the Connections page): {{explanation}}

accounts.authExpired: Authorization expired {{when}}; Edit, then authorize again.
accounts.publicOnSetting: On through the install-wide setting {{setting}}. Change it per account on the Connections page.
accounts.publicOnAccount: Set on this account's card on the Connections page. Every upload still waits for approval.
accounts.withoutApprovalTooltip: Set on this account's card on the Connections page. Publishes you start in the app go out without waiting on Approvals; requests from chat, MCP or a schedule still wait.
accounts.title: Social Accounts
accounts.postingStopped: Public posting is stopped. Resume it on the Outreach page.
accounts.queuedHeld: Queued publishes are held on the Approvals page; a scheduled post whose time comes meanwhile is held there too.
accounts.publishingDescription: Applies to every account on this page
accounts.publishingHelp: Publishing is posting your own content through these accounts. Outreach (replies on other people's threads) has its own switches on the Outreach page.
accounts.approvalNote: Every publish waits for your approval on the Approvals page, a scheduled one included; once approved it goes out at its time, sent by the platform where it schedules natively, otherwise by Guaardvark. The one exception, a Discord webhook into a channel you manage, is set on the Connections page. So is whether a YouTube account may upload publicly; it uploads as private until then.
accounts.providerMissing: {{name}}: its provider ({{provider}}) is not available on this install.
accounts.environmentNote: Detected in the backend process environment, managed outside the app and shown read-only.
accounts.storedOutside: Credentials are stored outside the database: {{state}}
accounts.removeDescription: Guaardvark forgets the account and its stored credentials. Nothing is deleted on the platform.
accounts.removeKeeps: the account itself and its posts on the platform; the post history here
